checks.name: sticky-source-navigation-and-customer-grouped-detail
checks.detail: One sticky left-aligned source switcher moves between WDF POS and LaundroPortal on every subject; source headings remain static so the previous source cannot stay pinned. The active analytics rail item collapses and reopens its report index. Standalone line/area panels fill the content width and reveal left-to-right. Customer distributions and grouped sales-versus-matched-void bars remain visible while only the directory is disclosed. Zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors.

checks.name: visualization-interaction-refinement
checks.detail: All part-to-whole charts use complete SVG ring-sector paths with stable category colours, direct percentage/value legends, segment hover/focus and 18% non-active opacity. The obsolete conic mask and 128px narrow-card SVG override were removed after they clipped rings. Operations limits departments to five and opens a monthly drill-down; standalone charts span 1092px of a 1160px main region. Source switching uses one left-aligned two-button control. Executive labels and badges fit without duplication or overflow, icons are distinct, product detail cards share row bounds, fees default to five lines with full disclosure, and no viewport has horizontal overflow or console errors.

checks.name: plain-language-headings-and-payment-status-clarity
checks.detail: Question-style headings are absent from the reviewed Executive and Orders routes. The unmatched-production card distinguishes production value from unknown payment status. Headless Chromium reports no console errors and exact 390px document width after the monthly-source chart mobile fix.

checks.name: refresh-safe-copy-and-large-executive-trends
checks.detail: Rolling and monthly revenue reports use large 190px plots in a two-column layout; yearly coverage spans the next row. Cash sales less payouts exposes both formula inputs. Visible Partial text is absent, fixed helper definitions replace changing interpretive prose, and all viewport document widths equal their client widths. Web tests: 88. Analytics tests: 77. Production web build, scoped ESLint, scoped Prettier and Ruff pass.

checks.name: compact-area-headers-pie-animation-and-operations-time-labels

Store operations renders full weekday and 12-hour time labels in the KPI and heatmap. Web tests: 89. Production build, scoped ESLint and Prettier pass.
